entities.name: Abdurrahman Yalçınkaya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdurrahman Yalçınkaya is a high-ranking Turkish judge and the former Chief Public Prosecutor of the Supreme Court of Appeals of Turkey. Since the end of his term on 2011, he has been a member of the Supreme Court of Appeals' Eight Civil Department.

entities.summary: Abdurrahman Yalçınkaya is a high-ranking Turkish judge and the former Chief Public Prosecutor of the Supreme Court of Appeals of Turkey. Since the end of his term on 2011, he has been a member of the Supreme Court of Appeals' Eight Civil Department.
